onednn.version_note: Official v3.14.2 tag resolves to this commit, whose CMakeLists.txt still sets PROJECT_VERSION3.14.1. Preserve the release source unchanged; check its actual runtime version separately.

dependency_policy: Newest stable components tested first. Preserve newer reference components. Use unmodified Torch2.15 with PTI1.2.1 rebuilt from its exact source plus upstream native-graph lifetime fix; no older Torch pin or native-recording fallback is needed after qualification.

metadata_overrides.core: Retain newer reference components and test latest SYCL2026.2/PTI1.2.1 beyond Torch2.15 exact metadata. Preserve CCL2022.1.2; never silently downgrade the reference.
metadata_overrides.vllm: Torch2.15, Transformers5.22.2, kernels0.1.17.1 and xgrammar0.2.9 exceed0.33 exact/range metadata; full profile qualification required, not a clean pip-check claim.
metadata_overrides.pti: Python metadata remains1.2.1; the two PTI libraries are rebuilt with the recorded upstream native-graph lifetime backport. Library hashes and source provenance are retained.

regression_probe.observed: Original Torch2.15/PTI1.2.1 produces wrong two-row graph outputs after XPU profiling, also in standalone PyTorch without vLLM/EXL3/Triton/weights.
regression_probe.selection: Backport Intel PTI native-graph resource/lifetime fix dd8940ff817f94461795708fe3c386ab9e09d3b1 to exact wheel source 25a77ed7693ac155bc62e563060b0976f9934b53. Original full matrix/attention/GDN gates and standalone native replay profiling (9 real kernel events) pass. Full final-image qualification remains required.

transformers.reason: 5.23 breaks vLLM0.33 two-pass Qwen video preprocessing. A valid2s320x240 clip is rejected as295241 tokens; the CPU integration also rejects the deferred video placeholder after the video has been processed separately.
transformers.control: Same Torch2.15/PTI-fixed image with only Transformers changed to5.22.2 passes the unchanged real1/4video count, rejection-over-limit and oversized-image API gate. Direct HF4-frame processing alone passes in both versions.
transformers.selection_rule: Latest compatible stable minor patch5.22.2, above the reference5.17.0. No other new component is rolled back. Full clean-image qualification still required.

inductor.selected: CompilationMode.NONE (0), native graph mode FULL_DECODE_ONLY retained
inductor.reason: Original frozen coding task degenerates into repeated duct and times out. Same-image1024-token captured-request control reproduces332 trailing repetitions; oldv7 and same-new-image without compilation do not. Enabling all native custom ops while keeping Inductor does not remove the repetition.
inductor.scope: Confirmed execution-path compatibility problem; exact defective optimization is not proven. Not a blanket PyTorch arithmetic attribution or a claim that graph capture must be disabled.
inductor.qualification: No release approval from this diagnostic; all final-image gates and full performance/quality comparison required.
